annotations.title: Read a web page or PDF as Markdown

description: Web page reader / scraper for AI agents: fetch one public URL and get clean Markdown of the main content (boilerplate, menus and scripts removed), or text from a PDF link. Returns title, description, language, author, publish date, word count, optional links, and an AI-usage hint (robots.txt AI crawler rules, Content-Signal, meta robots noai, X-Robots-Tag). Up to 100,000 chars. Failed fetches and JS-only pages are not charged. Price: 0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

ai_policy.description: Check robots.txt / meta / X-Robots-Tag AI-usage signals (default true)

include_links.description: Also return links found in the content

url.description: Public http(s) page or PDF URL

name: read_page
